text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has begun again this year. 
Last year her injury kept us from pushing hard, 
but this year there is nothing in the way.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Duramente admitted last year had been galling for her, 
and burned to train herself thoroughly this time.
